## Profile

I am an **Environment and Climate Economist** with training in economics and environmental economics. My research interests include applied microeconomics, causal inference, environmental economics, climate policy, green finance, and evidence-based environmental governance.

Research: *Green Growth Strategies Towards the Net-zero Transition: Low- and Middle-Income Countries Edition*

**London School of Economics and Political Science**, London, UK — Distinction  
Key modules: Environment &amp; Resource Economics, Applied Quantitative Methods, Economic Appraisal and Valuation  
Thesis: *Rainfall Shocks in Nepal and their Influence on Remittance Inflows: A Household-level Exploration*
